title: Second Lessons: Stars
introNarration: Lumen taps the Primer. Ink has dried on her primaries in a constellation of honest mistakes. "Cast azimuth at the hearth dummy in this room. Then talk to me. After that, the Primer will hold one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."
reminderNarration: Cast azimuth at the hearth dummy in this hearth, then talk to Lumen. Charts before wonder.
completionNarration: The second hearth lesson is done. The Primer lies open under the night windows. Open the Primer and type ink and the vein's name.
